name: Ingrid

scaling.scaled: Power snatches at a weight allowing touch-and-go triples when fresh; step-down burpee pacing from the start.
scaling.beginner: Dumbbell snatches and a fixed easy burpee cadence. The snatch-plus-burpee combination is about breathing rhythm, learnable at any load.

origin.summary: A newer Girl built on the snatch and burpee: technical barbell work paired with the sport's most democratic conditioning movement, in the classic short-couplet format. First posted to CrossFit.com on 2021-01-03.

description: Ten rounds of three snatches and three burpees over the bar, Grettel's snatch-based counterpart, the same rep and round scheme built around the more technical lift.
source_notes: crossfit.com/faq/wod (official CrossFit FAQ, 'Explain The Workouts with Names (the Girls)?'), retrieved 2026-07-08
